structured_output.what_is_happening: About 12 minutes ago a copycat "Effective Accelerationism" (e/acc) token launched on PumpSwap. It is one of at least 9 same-name copies created in the last ~30 minutes around a UsePaid token that sends its fees to @beffjezos (Guillaume Verdon, founder of the e/acc movement). The token's own description says it was "Created on https://usepaid.app/token/CbcyNo7m1amFWqEQm2m4PLv1UNvpcL3C1Ujm6AkzpKoU", which names a different mint, CbcyNo7..., as the original. That original is at about $800k market cap with $2.8M hourly volume. Our token's mint is not a pump.fun address, it was not created on the bonding curve, and its liquidity ($207k) is larger than its market cap ($145k), all of it in LP that is 100% unlocked. GMGN flags 50 bundler wallets holding about 26% of top-trader share. Only 55 unique sellers against 534 buyers, and $2M volume in 12 minutes, suggest scripted or bundled activity.

narrative.description: e/acc / Beff Jezos creator-fee token via UsePaid (fees paid to @beffjezos through X Money). Beff Jezos is a real, large account, and UsePaid creator-fee coins are a current meta.
narrative.why_spreading: A UsePaid token pointing fees to a famous X account (Beff Jezos) pulled attention. The canonical CbcyNo7 token ran to about $800k and set off a wave of clones.

token_connection.why_this_token: None found. This is a clone whose own description links to the canonical CbcyNo7 mint on UsePaid. It has no pump suffix and is not the fee-routed token.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Canonical: CbcyNo7m1amFWqEQm2m4PLv1UNvpcL3C1Ujm6AkzpKoU (~$797k mcap). Other clones: 3m7Bhp7 ($990k), 7dVWLAd ($274k), DseCuJ ($204k), 6TrwU9 ($127k) and more.

authenticity.evidence: 50 bundler wallets; 534 unique buyers but only 55 sellers; $2M volume on a $145k cap within 12 minutes; the pool was seeded with liquidity larger than the market cap, with 100% of LP unlocked and few LP providers; the description was copied from the canonical token.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not see the X post or which token Beff or other accounts actually shared. The pattern could partly be copy-trading bots rather than one operator.

structural_risks: 100% of LP unlocked in a custom PumpSwap pool, so the creator can pull liquidity at any time
Liquidity larger than market cap is typical of rug-pull setups
Clone competing with 9+ same-name tokens and a clear canonical one
Price already doubled from launch and m5 is negative

structured_output.counterargument: Clone waves sometimes lift every copy, and deep liquidity makes a quick dump less damaging. If Beff Jezos boosts e/acc, confused buyers could push this copy up 2x as well. The packet also shows mint and freeze authority renounced and no dev-history flags.
